contracts.inputs: Existing MeshAsset vertices/materials/images/samplers, live rigid instances and per-primitive ranges, resolved surface quality/shadows/RT budgets, shared lighting/environment/atlas
contracts.hit_lookup: Primitive-indexed 48-byte vertex records (position/normal/UV vec4s) and 48-byte material records; barycentric UV/smooth-normal interpolation, camera-relative rigid/uniform-scale transforms
contracts.texture_ownership: Raster TextureViews are reused through the existing material cache, with sRGB and linear roles kept separate. No image repacking, duplicate image upload, resize or optional bindless feature; samplers use the same wrap/filter constructor
contracts.sampling: Base colour is sRGB at every quality; High additionally samples linear MR (G roughness/B metallic), normal and AO. Low/Medium retain factor-only map fallbacks. Explicit LOD 0: no ray differentials/cones or mip chains
contracts.normal_frame: One shared tangent-frame function takes screen derivatives for raster or triangle position/UV edges for hits; includes mirrored-UV handedness and degenerate-UV fallback
contracts.shading: Shared GGX stellar BRDF, Fresnel/metallic diffuse partition, AO on indirect only; primary AO applies once to the full reflected chain (including directly lit secondary hits), not only misses. Hit roughness fades mirror continuation into the same directional environment approximation as raster. Single-direction rough-lobe approximation, not convolution or converged path tracing
contracts.shadow_visibility: One surface_visibility hook per source reused by diffuse and GGX. An opaque scene RT blocker returns zero; otherwise existing atlas visibility is retained, so RT cannot unshadow terrain. Stars are directional; shadow range uses resolved rt_max_distance_m and origin uses resolved rt_ray_bias_m
contracts.disabled: shadow_enabled=false issues no shadow rays. Specular off still permits shadow-only RT; both consumers disabled or RT off allocates/builds no RT scene. Shadow-only uses 16-byte positions and no reflection attribute/material/range/pair GPU tables or hit texture bindings
contracts.fallback: Static texture/sampler switch uses device limits with 5 slots reserved for the raster material/atlas. Excess hit bindings or RT storage/budget limits reject the whole reflection scene with rt_reason and raster fallback, never truncate. Shadow-only is independent of hit-material binding exhaustion
contracts.planning_bytes: Reflections: vertices*48 + indices*4 + primitives*(16 ranges +48 materials +256 BLAS estimate) + instance_capacity*(64 TLAS estimate +64 pairs). Shadow-only: vertices*16 + indices*4 + primitives*256 + instance_capacity*64. These are planning bytes, not driver allocation queries; shared raster textures excluded

oracles.numeric_tolerance: Independent analytic normal-incidence diffuse/GGX/sRGB fixtures compare each channel within 2/255; not just a nonzero image delta
oracles.white_star_red_dielectric: At roughness 1 and exposure 0.5: expected linear RGB=(0.485,0.005,0.005). White GGX lobe is required; the old pure-red threshold was invalid after direct GGX hit shading was added
new_cases: Non-central barycentric UV=(0.5,0.25), sRGB decode before bilinear filtering
Clamp/repeat/mirror addressing for positive and negative UVs
Same source image/texture sampled as sRGB base colour and linear MR
G roughness/B metallic channels, Low/Medium map omission
Rough hit consumes environment approximation; smooth hit continues the bounded ray chain

Primary AO zero/half strength attenuates the full reflected-hit chain once; hit AO affects indirect terms, not that hit's direct star term; normal map turns hit away from star; degenerate UV retains smooth normal
Off-camera blocker shadows a primary receiver with reflections off and no atlas; shadows-off and RT-off controls remain lit; distance cap excludes farther blocker
Separate blocker shadows a reflected hit without blocking the reflection ray
Binding exhaustion reports raster reflection fallback while shadow-only remains feasible
Two-quad planning bytes: 1584 textured reflection versus 944 shadow-only
oracles.retained_cases: The prior white-mirror and dielectric/AO environment misses, directional field and disabled/rebind oracles remain in the same suite
